description: Router created with `createBrowserRouter` / `createMemoryRouter` and rendered with `<RouterProvider>`. Enables loaders, actions and pending UI.
Function on a route that receives `{ params, request }` and returns data before the route renders.
Returns the data from the current route's loader.
Element rendered instead of the route element when its loader or render throws. Read the error with `useRouteError()`.
Creates a response with a status; thrown from a loader it becomes an error recognized by `isRouteErrorResponse`.
